decision.question: Where does the fast-assistant cleanup call run?

decision.question: How are the strike/add deltas produced?
options: the model returns the cleaned chunk and the page computes a word diff
the model returns a list of {strike, add} edits applied in order
decision.chose: cleaned chunk + word diff in the page
decision.why: The display is the same strike/add deltas the owner asked for, and a word diff can never mis-apply an edit the model located wrongly. Switch to model-emitted edits if the owner wants the model's own deltas logged.

findings.text: The fallback cleanup deletes real words: `FILLERS` in ux/Dictate/playground/Playground.js:25 removes every "like" and "i mean", so "I like the layout" becomes "I the layout". That breaks the owner's rule "never change the intent". Drop "like" and "i mean" from the rule pass and leave them to the model.

A new session can show the old session's corrections. `reset()` (Playground.js:115) swaps `clean_queue` for a fresh promise but does not cancel chunks that are already waiting. When their `clean_chunk()` finishes, it draws diff lines into the new session's Corrections and Live panels (Playground.js:304). Fix: stamp each entry with a session number and skip the drawing when the number is stale.

The "always visible" level meter does not show up in either sheet.png. Between the microphone picker and the tabs there is nothing a reader can recognise as a meter, at any width. The `--wash` track with its 1px `--line` border (Playground.css:26) is probably blending into the page. Give the empty track enough contrast to read as a meter (ask 3).

The empty Raw panel is a bare dark block (both sheet.png, all widths), so nothing tells the reader what will appear there. Show a muted line such as "press 🎤 or ▶ Sample — whisper's words appear here" until the first chunk arrives.

The label and the picker disagree: the label says "mic: default" while the select below it shows "microphone 1" (both sheets). Use one control that names the selected mic (Playground.js:254). A label next to a picker that says something different reads as a bug.
The intro on the Dictate page promises "side by side" (ux/Dictate/page.js:45), but the three views are tabs. Change the wording to say what is actually on the page.

The browser gives /api/tidy only 4 s before it falls back to the rules (Playground.js:73). The Agent SDK `query()` starts a new CLI process for every call, so a cold Sonnet reply may regularly take longer than that. The status line would then always say "rules". Time a few real calls, and consider a longer timeout or a warm session.

The rule pass's doubled-word collapse (Playground.js:62) also merges correct repeats such as "had had" and "that that". It also never capitalises a lone "i". This is acceptable for a fallback, but it is worth one line in doc/decisions.md.

`views` only ever grows (Playground.js:141). Every visit to the Overview or Playground tab adds another widget that stays alive after it leaves the screen, and it keeps receiving `meter()` and diff updates. Remove a widget from the set when it is no longer connected to the page.

`select_tab` rewrites the URL hash (Playground.js:200), so /framework/ux/Dictate/ always gains `#raw` just from loading. Check that the site Router ignores hashes. If the owner's tab rule wants real paths, this is the one route that is not a real path.

doc/decisions.md:9 still describes the round-1 `Playground.toolbar()` as the current shape, and round 2 comes further down. A new reader gets the dead design first. Fold round 1 into a short "replaced" line.

Space (both sheet.png): at 1920px and 3440px the widget stays about 550–700px wide while 70–86% of the page is empty. For a transcript view a wider panel would be better. The Dictate Overview also now has two 🎤 buttons (the playground widget, then the original exhibit), with the engine explanation between them. Put one sentence above the second mic saying how it differs from the first.

Asks 1–8 are all present in the code: one-click reset, device panel, a code-font raw view with a guess line that gets replaced, the tidy endpoint with strike/add deltas, red/green marks, the 5 s Live fade, and the Raw · Corrections · Live tabs. Ask 9 is deferred as the brief says. The screenshots only show the idle state, so none of these was seen running; a shot taken after ▶ Sample on each tab would prove them.
